citations.authors: Boyle KL, Olinick J, Lewis C
citations.title: The value of blowing up a balloon
citations.journal: North American Journal of Sports Physical Therapy
citations.what_it_says: Foundational PRI paper describing the 90/90 hemibridge with ball and balloon exercise to restore the diaphragm's zone of apposition; conceptual rather than a controlled outcome study.

citations.authors: Jackson LR, Purvis J, Brown T
citations.title: The effects of postural and anatomical alignment on speed, power, and athletic performance in male collegiate athletes: a randomized controlled trial
citations.journal: International Journal of Sports Physical Therapy
citations.what_it_says: Small RCT (n=25): non-manual PRI exercises improved agility and reduced hip asymmetries versus traditional intervention, but neither group improved vertical-jump power.

citations.authors: Fazel F, Zolaktaf V, Lenjan Nezhadian S
citations.title: The effect of exercise programs on pain management and motor control in patients with nonspecific chronic low back pain: a randomized matched subjects trial
citations.what_it_says: Randomized matched trial (n=33): NASM, PRI, and combined approaches produced comparable improvements in pain, disability, and motor control; PRI equivalent, not superior, to conventional exercise.

citations.authors: Waldron JL, McKenney MA, Samuel MN, Girouard TJ, Turner CL, Radzak KN
citations.title: The use of postural restoration for treatment of chronic rotator cuff pathology: a case report
citations.journal: International Journal of Sports Physical Therapy
citations.what_it_says: Single-patient case report: PRI intervention targeting pelvic alignment associated with reduced shoulder pain in a collegiate athlete with rotator cuff tendinopathy.

citations.title: Case study reflecting principles and treatment techniques of postural restoration
citations.what_it_says: Conference-proceedings case study claiming a pediatric scoliosis curve reduction over ~3 months using PRI techniques; very low-level, uncontrolled evidence.

citations.title: The effect of Postural Restoration Institute training on selected kinematic variables of lower limbs and pelvis during walking in middle-aged men with nonspecific chronic low back pain: a prospective observational study
citations.what_it_says: Prospective quasi-experimental study (n=42) of PRI training on gait kinematics in men with discogenic low back pain; modest kinematic changes after training.

citations.title: Effects of hemibridge with ball and balloon exercise on forced expiratory volume and pain in patients with chronic low back pain: an experimental study
citations.journal: International Journal of Medical Research & Health Sciences
citations.what_it_says: Small uncontrolled pre/post experiment (n=30) reporting immediate pain and FEV6 improvements after the PRI hemibridge exercise; low-impact non-indexed journal; weak evidence.

citations.authors: Kolar P, Sulc J, Kyncl M, Sanda J, Cakrt O, Andel R, Kumagai K, Kobesova A
citations.title: Stabilizing function of the diaphragm: dynamic MRI and synchronized spirometric assessment
citations.what_it_says: Rigorous dynamic-MRI/spirometry study demonstrating the diaphragm's dual postural-stabilizing and respiratory role; supports PRI's physiological premise without testing PRI itself.

citations.authors: Sembera M, Busch A, Kobesova A, Hanychova B, Sulc J, Kolar P
citations.title: Postural-respiratory function of the diaphragm assessed by M-mode ultrasonography
citations.what_it_says: Ultrasonography study showing diaphragm excursion during load-lifting independent of respiration, reinforcing the postural-respiratory dual-function concept.

citations.title: Breathing pattern disorders and functional movement
citations.journal: International Journal of Sports Physical Therapy
citations.what_it_says: Cross-sectional study (n=34): individuals with breathing-pattern disorder signs scored significantly worse on the Functional Movement Screen, supporting the breathing-posture link.
